highlights: Result Update 04th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 2,090 DOMS Industries Ltd Stationery 1 Margins Headwind Continues Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – INLINE; EBITDA – BEAT; PAT – MISS Changes in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -1%/-3%; EBITDA: -13%/-14%; PAT: -18%/-19% Recommendation Rationale • Revenue Performance: DOMS reported 17.6% YoY revenue growth in Q2FY27, driven by capacity additions over the past year, traction from new product launches and volume growth across both domestic and export markets.

However, unusually heavy rainfall and flooding in Gujarat impacted growth by an estimated 300–350bps. • Margin Pressure: DOMS reported a sharp decline in profitability in Q2FY27, with gross margin contracting 472bps YoY to 39.1% and EBITDA declining 16.8% YoY, with a 513bps margin contraction.

Additionally, the Reynolds acquisition led to a temporary cost-revenue mismatch, as the full sales and support payroll became effective from 1st July, while revenue contribution was delayed due to the relocation of assets to Umargaon. • Growth Guidance: Management targets 18–20% sales growth and an EBITDA margin of 16– 17%, subject to market conditions.
